title: The Kiavah Wilderness at the pass
text: Highway 178 crosses Walker Pass at the north boundary of the Kiavah Wilderness. The wilderness was created in 1994 by the California Desert Protection Act, and it takes in the Scodie Mountains. Pinyon pine, juniper, and Joshua trees grow there. The Pacific Crest Trail travels the length of the wilderness for 17 miles.
